description: 5₂ Stokes matrix bar-split: the even (meson, m_π) channel E is diagonal-dominated (33% off-diagonal — abelian, pure saddles); the odd (lepton/weak, Q_β) channel O is off-diagonal-dominated (53% — non-abelian saddle-mixing). The off-share flips across the even/odd boundary — the Stokes-matrix signature of m_π computable (abelian) vs Q_β/c₃ scalar-unreachable (non-abelian). Physical lepton/meson-mixing reading flagged as interpretation, not derived.

data.verdict: MESON CHANNEL ABELIAN, LEPTON CHANNEL NON-ABELIAN (scope-(a) structural). The GGM 5₂ Stokes matrix splits under bar (q↔q⁻¹) into E=½(S⁺+S⁻) [even=meson, m_π/CAL-3] and O=½(S⁺−S⁻) [odd=weak/lepton, Q_β/CAL-2]. Decomposing each into diagonal (abelian, pure saddle) vs off-diagonal (non-abelian, saddle-MIXING): E is 33.4% off-diagonal (MAJORITY diagonal — meson saddles nearly pure); O is 52.8% off-diagonal (MAJORITY off-diagonal — the mixing lives in the lepton/weak channel). The off-share FLIPS across the even/odd (meson/lepton) boundary. This is the Stokes-matrix signature of two corpus facts: m_π (bar-even) is cleanly independent + SDP-validated (abelian ⇒ computable); Q_β/c₃ (bar-odd) resists every scalar closed form (non-abelian ⇒ scalar-unreachable). Anchor-stable. INTERPRETATION (flagged, not derived): the odd-channel off-diagonal is the natural home of a lepton/meson channel-mixing reading — no mixing angle or observable is derived here. No fit; no c_k; no tier change.
